_readme: All lengths in mm. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored. Run: python generate.py [other_params.json]

rail._note: MIL-STD-1913 Picatinny profile. Only change these if your rail measures differently.
rail._RAIL_APEX_WIDTH: Width at the point of the 'V' on each side (narrowest point of the dovetail)

clamp._note: Two-piece cross-bolt clamp: the fixed jaw is part of the body, the moving jaw is a separate part pulled in by the bolts. The bolts sit in the rail's recoil slots.
clamp._BODY_LENGTH: Length along the rail (X); also the housing length
clamp._CLAMP_WALL: Side wall outside the rail top width
clamp._CLAMP_FLOOR: Material between the base plate top and the rail top
clamp._JAW_DEPTH: How far the jaws reach up past the rail top (rail top -> clamp top)
clamp._RAIL_CLEARANCE: Gap on each flank between rail and jaw
clamp._FLOOR_GAP: Gap under the rail top so the clamp pulls on the flanks, not the top
clamp._JAW_SPLIT_Y: Where the moving jaw is split off from the body (Y from rail centre line)
clamp._JAW_GAP: Clamping travel between moving jaw and body
clamp._BOLT_SPACING_SLOTS: Bolt spacing in rail slot pitches (2 = 20.02 mm)
clamp._BOLT_FROM_RAIL_TOP: Bolt centre measured from the rail top into the rail; the bolt must stay inside RAIL_SLOT_DEPTH
clamp._NUT_RECESS: Extra depth of the nut pocket past the nut, so the bolt tip stays below the surface
clamp._BASE_PLATE: Plate the moving jaw rests on; also the roof of the leg bore

housing._note: Hangs under the clamp. Holds the leg (keyed so it cannot spin) and the thumb wheel pocket.
housing._HOUSING_WIDTH: Across the rifle (Y). The wheel sticks out past this on both sides
housing._TRAVEL: Height adjustment range. The housing grows by this much
housing._LOWER_GUIDE: Keyed bore length under the wheel pocket (was 10) - longer guide = less leg wobble
housing._POCKET_CLEARANCE_HEIGHT: Total up/down gap for the wheel (was 0.8) - this is the leg's up/down play
housing._BORE_CLEARANCE: Radial gap between the leg thread crests and the housing bore

thread._note: 45 degree flanks so both the leg and the wheel print without supports. One wheel turn moves the leg THREAD_PITCH mm.
thread._THREAD_CLEARANCE: Added to the wheel's internal thread, radially and axially. Raise if the wheel binds

leg._KEY_WIDTH: Width of the anti-rotation groove along the leg
leg._KEY_GROOVE_RADIUS: Radius of the groove floor (thread minor radius is major/2 - depth)
leg._KEY_CLEARANCE: Gap on each side of the key rib (was 0.3) - sets how much the leg can twist
leg._LEG_EXPOSED: Leg left showing under the housing when fully retracted
leg._COLLAR_HEIGHT: 45 degree collar where the leg meets the sled; must be less than LEG_EXPOSED

sled._note: Sled foot runs along the rail so the rifle slides straight back under recoil. Both ends curl up like sledge runners; the curve starts at 45 degrees so it prints without supports.
sled._SLED_TIP_HEIGHT: Top of the curled tips above the running surface
sled._SLED_CURVE_RADIUS: Radius of the runner curve at each end
sled._SLED_TIP_FILLET: Concave curve where the tips rise out of the deck

output._note: Point these somewhere else in a copy of this file to keep several variants side by side.
output._PREVIEW_RAIL: Draw a ghost Picatinny rail in the preview to check the fit
